# Core Libraries

Follow the rules defined in [.claude/rules-snippets/core-libraries.md](../../.claude/rules-snippets/core-libraries.md).

Key points:
- Use @open-sunsama/utils for common utilities and TanStack Query for state management.
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling; prefer utility classes over custom CSS.
- Use Radix UI for UI components; check existing components before creating new ones.
- Prefer shared packages from `packages/` over app-local duplicates.
